## Checklist

- [ ] `bash scripts/test.sh` and `bash scripts/check_mock.sh` pass
- [ ] UI change: attached screenshots from `bash scripts/dev.sh shots` (and `shots en` if text changed)
- [ ] New or changed user-visible strings are in `homedash.koplugin/homedash_i18n.lua` (`en` and `pl`)
- [ ] Config changes are reflected in `homedash.koplugin/config.example.lua` and `docs/configuration.md`
- [ ] No real Home Assistant calls in tests, no tokens or private addresses committed
